facts.fact: Bindu's wool is dyed with walnut husk; Jassi's goat-brown sleeve is her weave.
Bindu's knot-song for the wrist knot runs 'Two over, one under, the third one tells the truth.'

Rohan has crossed by writ before with the post's paired guides and seen cairn-light only a lamp's throw; he has never seen the line run so far ahead so fast. Paid guides tie for a fee, and Meera says the mountain can tell the difference.
A warden cannot read cairn-song: the stones' hum dips at a true word but never says who spoke, so Meera's pink fingertips are the only proof Rohan can read. Applies F387 and F320.
